description: This file defines the EntitySyncServices class, providing services for entity synchronization processes such as running sync operations (push/pull), offline export/import, and cleanup. It includes complex logic for handling data synchronization workflows, error handling, and XML serialization.

classes.name: EntitySyncServices
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for various entity synchronization services such as push, pull, offline import/export, and cleanup operations.

methods.name: runEntitySync
methods.description: Initiates an entity synchronization process that checks for ongoing operations, splits sync jobs, and manages data transfer for push synchronization.

methods.name: storeEntitySyncData
methods.description: Stores sync data received during synchronization, handling inserts, updates, and deletes accordingly.

methods.name: runPullEntitySync
methods.description: Executes a pull-based entity synchronization, retrieving data from a remote source and storing it locally in multiple iterations.

methods.name: pullAndReportEntitySyncData
methods.description: Called remotely to push local sync results and retrieve the next batch of data for synchronization.

methods.name: runOfflineEntitySync
methods.description: Performs an offline export of entity data to an XML file, including serialization of data lists.

methods.name: loadOfflineSyncData
methods.description: Loads offline synchronization data from a specified XML file and stores it locally.

methods.name: updateOfflineEntitySync
methods.description: Placeholder for a future feature to update offline sync data; currently not implemented.

methods.name: cleanSyncRemoveInfo
methods.description: Removes old synchronization removal info based on defined retention policies.
